name: Tool — Memory
description:
`MemorySearchPreviewTool` would let a Prompt Agent search a persisted memory store while the host agent's orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. Memory store creation itself takes a `chat_model` and `embedding_model` — those are separate model slots from the agent orchestrator, and both must resolve to a real deployment on the Foundry account.

Probed via `AIProjectClient(allow_preview=True).beta.memory_stores.create(...)` with a BYOM-prefixed `chat_model`. Foundry rejects the create with `bad_request`:

> Chat model deployment 'apim-3swd46vd3j22a-openai-s-for-ai-project-3swd46vd3j22a-1/gpt-4o-mini' was not found.

See `test.py`, which asserts the rejection. The agent orchestrator model can still be BYOM-routed, but the memory store itself must be backed by a native Foundry deployment, so the feature as a whole is not BYOM-compatible.
notes: Memory is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations. Empirically confirmed 2026-07-20: `MemoryStoreDefaultDefinition.chat_model` does not accept a `{conn}/{deployment}` prefix.
